caption: The drawing depicts a scene with two human figures and a building structure. On the left side stands a figure dressed in Renaissance-style clothing, including a blue cape with red trim, a red and blue hat with a feather, yellow pants, and brown footwear. The figure holds a long rifle or musket pointed towards the right. On the right side of the drawing, there is a tall, cylindrical brick tower with details such as windows and architectural decorations at the top. In front of the tower stands another figure, this one smaller, dressed in a red shirt, brown shorts, and a cap, positioned on stone steps that lead up to the base of the tower. The scene is set on an oblong and flat base, which appears textured and colored in shades of brown and green. The color palette includes muted earth tones, reds, blues, and yellows.
title: Toy Bank: William Tell
